blocks.text: Truzzo, Truzzi (Plural) or Truzza (Feminine Term) is a youth subculture in Italy that gained popularity between the late 1990s and late 2000s. It is related to electronic dance music (Techno and Eurodance), vibrant, flashy designer-logo clothing, party-centric lifestyle that shares similarities to Guido and the Scene aesthetic. It was historically set as the direct cultural contradiction of metal-related subcultures (Metallari) and rock in the 1990s, before it later counterbalanced the emo subculture of the late 2000s.

It features heavy layers of hair gel, bright, loud or neon patterns, counterfeit designer brands (or imitations), tight clothing, chunky accessories or fake pearls, and plastic sunglasses. It is based around beach clubs, discotheques, weekend nightlife, and motorbikes such as scooters. For the edited images, they use Blingee, where they put their captured photos with stickers and texts resembling a low quality photo output.
